experiences.description: Computer engineering studies with interests in embedded software, electronics, hardware integration and real-time systems. Expected graduation: April 2027.
Worked in an industrial manufacturing environment in Guelph, Ontario.
Held full-time and part-time contract positions involving resource management and project coordination.

projects.title: Wireless Air-Quality Monitoring System
projects.summary: Team capstone exploring low-cost wireless monitoring of ammonia, temperature, and humidity in agricultural environments.
projects.description: Ongoing group capstone focused on sensor evaluation, embedded data acquisition, wireless communications, and environmental monitoring. Proposed approaches compare MOS and electrochemical ammonia sensing. Detailed implementation and results will be added after testing and approval to publish. Project image is illustrative; more build photographs can be added as available.

projects.title: Autonomous Vehicle Design
projects.summary: Arduino-based autonomous vehicle with motor control, sensors, and electronic circuit design.
projects.description: Programmed an Arduino in C to control the vehicle's motors and sensors for autonomous navigation. Designed motor-power circuitry and created AutoCAD drawings related to the motor controller and vehicle power system.

projects.title: Motor Reverse Engineering
projects.summary: Disassembled and studied a motor, then recreated its components and mechanism in SolidWorks.
projects.description: Collaborated with a team of five to analyze a physical motor and model its components. Created detailed parametric models, assembled the mechanism, and produced an animation showing the motor shaft's motion. Project image is illustrative; more build photographs can be added as available.

projects.title: YouTube Interface & Data Workflow
projects.summary: Built a YouTube-style frontend with HTML/CSS and worked on a Laserfiche API data workflow.
projects.description: Developed a YouTube-inspired frontend using HTML and CSS. Also worked with NetBeans and the Laserfiche API on dataset filtering and file-management automation. Project image is illustrative; more build photographs can be added as available.
